technical_decisions: BRep nguồn chân thực qua qymcad-kernel, không chạy Boolean trên mesh và gọi đó là exact CAD.
Trường hợp Box overlap: intersection=500, union=1500, difference=500 mm³; kiểm tra BRepCheck_Analyzer và phân loại non-manifold/naked edges.
Map TopoDS history Generated/Modified/Deleted qua document persistent refs. Lỗi phải abort transaction và không bỏ lại shape pointer.

input.purpose: cap open planar boundaries and validate closure

positive.setup: Create the geometry and select the inputs required by: cap open planar boundaries and validate closure
positive.expected: Build exact valid BRep; compare topology, bounding box and area/volume against independent geometry oracle, then save and reopen.

negative.setup: Use degenerate wire, null shape, zero/negative radius/height or impossible tolerance appropriate to Planar Cap And Close Solid
negative.expected: Explicit domain error; document IDs, BRep cache, selection and undo journal unchanged

invariants: No success with only tessellation when an exact BRep is required
Do not infer success from an unrun test
